title: Spotted lanternfly spread rate: natural dispersal vs human-aided jumps

source.name: Human-mediated dispersal drives the spread of the spotted lanternfly (Lycorma delicatula)
source.publisher: Scientific Reports (Nature Portfolio), Ladin et al. 2022

notes: The study found a natural, diffusive spread rate (local hopping/walking/short flights) of about 25 km/yr (~16 miles), versus discrete long-distance jump events of 55-92 km/yr (~34-57 miles) attributed to human-mediated transport (vehicles, trains). The upper end of the human-aided range (~57 miles) is shown here for contrast with natural spread.
